// diagnostic

E0157

`state {type} { … }` is not a type declaration

What

`state {type} { … }` is not a type declaration

Why

Typestate facts belong to the struct that owns them; a sibling declaration repeats the type name and creates a false namespace boundary

Fix

Move the states into the owner: write `struct {type}` with `state {states}` inside its body

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0157: tests/ui/typestate_top_level_state.stderr.

Error [E0157]: `state Order { … }` is not a type declaration
  --> tests/ui/typestate_top_level_state.jet:2:1
    |
 2 | state Order { Draft, Confirmed }
   | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: typestate facts belong to the struct that owns them; a sibling declaration repeats the type name and creates a false namespace boundary
 Fix: move the states into the owner: write `struct Order` with `state { Draft, Confirmed }` inside its body
